title: Affine fibre etaleness via the section tensor algebra
statement: Let f:X→Y be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism], U an affine open of Y, and y∈U. Put R=Γ(Y,U), B=Γ(X,f⁻¹U), k=κ(y) [def-weil-residue-field], with R-algebra structures induced by f and evaluation. Then the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] X_y→Spec k is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] if and only if k⊗_R B is an etale k-algebra. No finiteness assumption on B is required.

proof.text: Use IsOpenImmersion.isPullback on the affine chart maps from Spec R and Spec B. The commutative square follows from IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec and Hom.appLE_eq_app; the opens-range equality follows from preimage affineness.
Factor the residue point map as Spec(evaluation) followed by the affine chart map, using evaluation=germ followed by residue and IsAffineOpen.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk.
Use pullbackSpecIso R k B to form the tensor-product pullback square, paste it with the chart square, and obtain an isomorphism to the scheme-theoretic fibre over Spec k.

Cancel this isomorphism with MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso; HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and RingHom.etale_algebraMap identify etaleness of the resulting Spec map with Algebra.Etale k (k tensor_R B).

lean.statement:
theorem etale_fibre_iff_etale_tensor_section_algebra
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ U.1) :
    letI := (f.app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (Y.evaluation U.1 y hy).hom.toAlgebra
    Etale (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y) ↔
      Algebra.Etale (Y.residueField y)
        (TensorProduct (Γ(Y, U.1)) (Y.residueField y) (Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))
